items.text: Final report: Denver ruled out RB Tyler Badie (thumb), OLB Jonah Elliss (ankle) and S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle); CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) and RB Jonah Coleman are questionable. WR Pat Bryant is on IR.

Final report: Arizona ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle), OL Jon Gaines II, DL Walter Nolen III and S Andrew Wingard; S Budda Baker (groin/illness), DL Darius Robinson, CB Max Melton and backup QB Carson Beck are questionable. RB James Conner and OT Paris Johnson are on IR; Jacoby Brissett starts.
